author: SA Editors' Picks
title: Sell In May And Go Away? - Today's Editors' Picks
text:
Hello! I'm your curator, Michael Hopkins. We've entered May. And, as we reach that pinnacle in terms of quarterly reporting, can companies deliver stellar earnings? Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) did, beating on both revenues and earnings for its fiscal second quarter.
Could tech regain its footing and keep the momentum going? The April jobs report comes out Friday - could the data stifle markets? Could global developments, such as those on the Korean peninsula , help or hurt sentiment? And can Wall Street ever move higher, or will markets remain stuck in neutral , or possibly head lower? Maybe we should just rely on i nvestment advice from our mothers .
Could it be "sell in May, and go away?"
We have Editors' Picks from Mike Arnold , Michael Fitzsimmons , BZ Equity Research , Brad Thomas , Stephen Simpson , and Hoya Capital Real Estate , among others.
Here are today's Editors' Picks:
Long Ideas:
Radcom (Mike Arnold) Phillips 66 Partners (Michael Fitzsimmons) ContraVir (BZ Equity Research) Neurocrine (Stephen Simpson) Kimco (Brad Thomas) Short Ideas:
Landmark Infrastructure (SA Editor Daniel Shvartsman) General Outlook:
Student Housing REITs (Hoya Capital Real Estate) Korea and the markets (SA For FAs) Mom as financial advisor (SA For FAs) Chart of the day : Student housing REITs vs. other REIT sectors .
Comment of the day , from fugilomi .
Mom knows best, she always told me to buy good companies and hold forever, but the trader in me didn't want to listen. My parents made us earn allowances by doing chores, and other than getting gifts on Christmas and birthdays, they would not give us any extra money to buy things we wanted that were not absolutely necessary like clothes, no loans either, so we had to save to buy stuff like marbles, toy soldiers and candy. That was the best training I ever got as a child to save and budget.
Image of the day : Gray Oak Pipeline delivers .
Fun fact of the day :
The Beastie Boys started their own record label, Grand Royal, in 1992 with Luscious Jackson as the first signing. Grand Royal was shut down due to financial difficulty in 2001. Other artists on the label included Sean Lennon and Atari Teenage Riot.
Thanks for reading. Please share your "Editor's Pick" with fellow investors by posting it in the comments.
Have a great day!
Michael
